text:
The plate is a square side plate of roughly 20-22 cm. It holds chopped fried or scrambled egg, probably about 2 eggs' worth at around 100 g, plus about 5 slices of chorizo or sausage at roughly 40 g.

Energy estimate:
- Egg, about 100 g at roughly 150 kcal per 100 g with the cooking fat, gives about 150 kcal.
- Chorizo, about 40 g at roughly 4.5 kcal/g, gives about 180 kcal.

That makes about 330 kcal and 140 g in total. The sausage pieces are small, about 3 cm across and maybe 8 g each, so 5 pieces come to roughly 40 g. The egg may be a bit more than I assumed, so I'll settle on roughly 300 kcal and 130 g.

{"kcal": 300, "mass_g": 130}
